verdict.rationale: Superpowers is an open-source skills plugin. Its skills live as plain SKILL.md files in the public repo's `skills/` directory, which is "the source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness" (docs-13, docs-37). That lets a lead read the instructions on GitHub or in a git-clone install before and after adopting them (docs-15, docs-16, docs-17, docs-53). The evidence shows no dedicated pre-install manifest or inspection workflow. The session-start hook that injects context (docs-28, gh-8) is not enumerated, and the Codex/OpenCode install has the agent fetch and follow a remote INSTALL.md, which is harder to review (comm-5). Missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing, a documented install location or audit path for every installed file, an enumeration of the hooks and scripts added alongside the skill text, and independent corroboration of a review workflow.
